items.title: l-torsion of the Picard group of a reduced connected proper curve is bounded by genus plus geometric genus, with equality exactly for multicross singularities
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The proposition bounds the l-torsion of Picard by g + g_geom and characterizes equality (statement lines 3700-3713). The proof (lines 3715-3783) runs a genuine rank bookkeeping over a factorization of the normalization into elementary modifications: three exact sequences on Picard with the l-divisibility of k^* and (k,+) deciding which steps change the rank, the endpoint values on the normalization, the counting bound g - g_geom, and the equality characterization through lemma-multicross in both directions. H3: the orchestration of the three step types with the divisibility analysis is a real argument, not a reference chase.
